title: Go Team!
plot_overview: A struggling Spanish cheese company sends its rural workforce on a team-building retreat, hoping to strengthen cooperation. Instead, tensions rise as workplace rivalries, betrayal, and the threat of layoffs expose the absurdity of corporate culture.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy sharp workplace satire and uncomfortable group dynamics; Not for you if you prefer straightforward comedies without betrayal, layoffs, or corporate tension.
review_summary: Pros: workplace satire; rural setting; corporate absurdity | Cons: tense office politics; possible bleak tone; limited context
